quote: The driver of a motor vehicle shall not intentionally interfere with the movement of a person lawfully riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter.

activation.condition: A motor-vehicle driver encounters a person riding a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.

obligation.description: Intentionally interfere with the movement of that person while lawfully riding.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Intent must be evidenced independently of scripted route or proximity.
Causal interference cannot be inferred from clearance alone.
The human bicycle rider and lawful status require original source review.

parameter_refs.name: commanded_ego_lateral_path
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: clear or intrusion route request; neither is a legal outcome
